blocks.raw: <Tip>The UAP (United Architects of the Philippines) is automatically accredited as a CPD provider — no separate application needed. Other organizations must undergo the standard accreditation process. Programs offered directly by UAP carry full accreditation authority automatically.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>CPD provider accreditation is valid for **three years**. Activities delivered by a provider whose accreditation has expired do NOT generate valid CPD credits — regardless of content quality. Always verify accreditation status before enrolling. The Board maintains a current list of accredited providers.</ExamTip>
